scoring_justification: Agent submits only the final numeric scores; no raw DFT/MC trajectories or per‑atom outputs are provided, so full recompute from raw artifacts is not feasible. We compare the reported values to paper gold with appropriate tolerances (T0 result‑level comparison).

schema.description: Total magnetic moment per unit cell in μB and magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy in meV/f.u.

outputs.description: Scored artifact reporting magnetic moment and MAE.

schema.description: Exchange coupling parameters J1, J2, J3 in meV.

outputs.description: Scored artifact reporting exchange parameters from Ising model fit.

schema.description: A single floating‑point number on the first line, representing the Curie temperature in Kelvin.

outputs.description: Scored artifact reporting Curie temperature from Monte Carlo simulation.

schema.description: SOC-induced band gap in meV and Chern number (integer).

outputs.description: Scored artifact reporting band gap with SOC+U and Chern number.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are compared to paper‑reported values within hidden tolerances (T0 result-level comparison). The exchange_parameters step is load‑bearing to ensure the Monte Carlo process is directly linked to the fitted parameters.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for all scored quantities (magnetic moment 2.0 μB, MAE 5.3 meV, J1=26.86 meV, J2=3.00 meV, J3=0.12 meV, Curie temperature 528 K, SOC band gap 68.6 meV, Chern number -1).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Directly transcribed from the source paper (main text, Section III.B, III.C, III.E) and confirmed by the reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The gold values are the paper’s own reported numbers; the reference oracle (solve.sh) writes exactly these numbers to verify the full‑reward path.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All quantities are taken verbatim from the published paper, with units identical to the output contract; no synthetic or guessed values are used.

steps.description: Compare magnetic moment and MAE to paper gold.
Compare exchange parameters to paper gold (load‑bearing).
Compare Curie temperature to 528 K within 15 K.
Compare SOC gap and Chern number to paper gold.
